title: Morgan Stanley and Citigroup Incorporated - Joint Venture

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC decided not to intervene in the proposed joint venture.

body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the proposed joint venture to be in the market for the supply of wealth management services.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered the proposed joint venture was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the market for the supply of wealth management services. In reaching this view the ACCC noted that Morgan Stanley has a small presence in the wealth management market in Australia, the continued presence of a large number of competitors in the market post-joint venture, and the low barriers to entry in the market.
